items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: MS. REDD: 1925, Andrew Blakeney recorded with the Sonny Clay's Plantation Orchestra... The personnel included... Leonard Davidson, clarinet

ctx.x: Yes, he was very active in that time. He hired quite a few musicians during the time.
Leonard Davidson, "Big Boy", was with him during this time thereabout and he continued to do so throughout this period until about World War II, when the whole scene started to branch out a bit more.
Do you remember Ivie's Chicken Shack?
